parsed.rationale: Both `TestPerson` (CacheCoordinatorTests.swift:71) and `CachedPerson` (CachedFetchTests.swift:257) are `type-alias-object` declarations residing under `Shared/Caching/Tests/CachingTests/` — a test target by path convention — making them test fixtures despite the `is_test: false` tagging gap in the pipeline. Each alias exists to give a locally meaningful name to the same underlying cacheable Person type within its own test file, which is standard Swift test-fixture practice. Consolidating them into a shared test helper would couple two independent test suites (`CacheCoordinatorTests` and `CachedFetchTests`) for no production benefit, and the names themselves (`TestPerson`, `CachedPerson`) signal deliberate per-suite naming rather than accidental duplication.
